captions.text: Create a note, then search it with SQL. One match.
A real Postgres engine answered. No server involved.
PGlite: Postgres compiled to WebAssembly, loaded like an asset.
Here it ran under Node against a folder on disk.
Working memory and the data directory are two different places.
memory:// loses the note on close. The filesystem dir keeps it.
Browser: idb://video-notes is IndexedDB for this origin and profile.
Reload, same origin and profile: the note should still be there.
A service worker precaches the shell and all engine files.
Same origin, versioned cache. Finish caching before going offline.
Offline reload and edit: the write goes to IndexedDB.
If it fails in your browser, report it. Do not film a success.
Clean profile, same address: no notes.
Node analogue: a second data dir sees zero.
Clear site data: the note and the cache are gone.
The browser owns this storage and may remove it.
Local persistence is not cloud sync — or a backup.
One origin, one profile, one device.
